limitations: Queries and selected primary sources only; no systematic database or citation-network review.
A full_text_selected_equations or full_text_selected_sections label records selected inspection of the complete document, not a full linear reading.
Relevance screens include competing names such as volume reactivity, rebinding, finite repairs, spatial proofreading, and autocatalysis; exact-phrase queries have low recall.
Negative evidence is limited to the retrieved and examined material.
An encounter-memory paper was accessible only through publisher search excerpts.
No external specialist review was solicited.
